acceptance_status_semantics.SUPPORTED: implementation E2E required: the full defined acceptance path must pass
acceptance_status_semantics.PARTIAL: bounded acceptance only: the explicitly bounded/in-scope path must pass and the report must name what remains outside scope; NOT a full E2E claim; NOT upgraded to SUPPORTED
acceptance_status_semantics.NOT_IMPLEMENTED: NO implementation E2E required; the feature/category must be explicitly recorded as not implemented, with a documented blocked record naming the missing prerequisite
acceptance_status_semantics.DEFERRED: NO implementation E2E required; the deferral and its dependency must be explicit
forbidden: requiring an E2E implementation result for a NOT_IMPLEMENTED or DEFERRED category
treating a documented blocked/deferred outcome as a gate failure
treating a documented blocked/deferred outcome as delivery of the category
redefining the status vocabulary inside an individual phase gate
